1	# webERP database, install, transaction posting and reporting
2	
3	This is the webERP application: the code that installs and upgrades its MySQL/MariaDB database, the pages that run sales, purchasing, stock, manufacturing and ledger postings, and the reports and documents built from the results. It hands work to MySQL, `mysqldump`/`gzip`, Dompdf, SMTP, FTP, Nominatim, Google Translate and currency feeds, and takes version state and settings from `config` and the session.
4	
5	## The areas
6	
7	- **Database upgrade and migration scripts.** Carries a database forward from 2.7 to the current release on two separate tracks. The legacy `.sql` track is driven by `VersionNumber`, but it is reached only when the `VersionNumber` row is missing or `scripts.pagesecurity` cannot be read (`source/webERP/includes/GetConfig.php:30-43`). The numbered PHP updates in `sql/updates/` are driven by `DBUpdateNumber`. It also holds the backup page, the one-off per-version pages, the user-defined sales-report SQL builder and the form-field helpers. It takes version state from `config` and the session. It leaves tables and config keys that every other area reads. The installer includes its `UpgradeDB_<DBType>` helpers. The reporting area runs the report builder.
8	
9	- **Installer, seed data, schema, API, QA, MRP, petty cash, admin pages, tests and build tooling.** Builds a fresh database through the six-step wizard, seeds charts of accounts, menus and security, and provides the login/session bootstrap. It also holds the XML-RPC API, MRP, QA samples, the petty-cash cycle, CSV imports, settings pages, and the CI and release scripts. It hands the other areas their tables and sessions. Its API and petty-cash pages post into the same ledgers as the posting area. The `gltotals` triggers it installs are MySQL-only, and a trigger failure counts only as a warning (`source/webERP/includes/InstallFunctions.php:737-753`).
10	
11	## Flows across areas
12	
13	1. The session bootstrap (installer area) compares only `DBVersion` with `DBUpdateNumber` and redirects to the upgrade area. It does not compare `VersionNumber`, although the comment at line 272 says it does (`source/webERP/includes/session.php:272-293`). `GetConfig` sends users to `UpgradeDatabase.php` only when the `VersionNumber` row is missing or `scripts.pagesecurity` cannot be read, and the second of those redirects has no `exit()` (`source/webERP/includes/GetConfig.php:30-43`). A database on an old legacy version that still has a `VersionNumber` row is therefore never sent to the legacy `.sql` scripts. It goes straight to numbered updates 0..N, which assume the 4.15.x schema.
14	
15	## Conventions
16	
17	  - Among the numbered updates, 0–16, 25–35 and 43 call `UpdateDBNo` only when `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors']` is 0. Updates 17–24 and 36–42 call it unconditionally (`source/webERP/includes/UpgradeDB_mariadb.php:751-757`, `source/webERP/sql/updates/42.php:1-11`). The newest file, 43, is guarded but 42 is not, so the next update copied from either one decides whether failures stop the version number.
18	
19	  - In the XML-RPC API, `WorkOrderIssue` is the pattern to copy. It fetches its transaction number once (`source/webERP/api/includes/api_workorders.php:294`). `StockAdjustment` and `WorkOrderReceive` read the item row at the wrong index, so GL posts come out zero or blank. `StockAdjustment` also calls `GetNextTransNo(17)` four times, so the stockmove, the two GL rows and the final `systypes` update each get a different transaction number. Its GL lines cannot be tied to each other or to the stockmove by type and number, and inquiries and balance checks see each line as an unbalanced one-line transaction. The increments also run before `DB_Txn_Begin`, so their `FOR UPDATE` locks are not held (`source/webERP/api/includes/api_stock.php:787-848`, `source/webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php:16-26`).
20	
21	  - `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` is called only by the API invoice and credit-note functions. No web posting page calls it (`source/webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php:346-373`, `source/webERP/api/includes/api_salesorders.php:1377-1443`).
22	
23	## Hazards
24	
25	- The two version markers do not verify each other. `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors']` accumulates across the whole upgrade run and is not reset between updates. After one guarded update fails, every later guarded update still runs its SQL but skips `UpdateDBNo`, while the unguarded updates (17–24 and 36–42) advance `DBUpdateNumber` anyway, so the failed update is never retried. Updates that skipped `UpdateDBNo` have already applied their DDL and rerun on the next attempt (`source/webERP/Z_UpgradeDatabase.php:50-57`, `source/webERP/Z_UpgradeDatabase.php:121-139`).
26	
27	- Update 17 sets `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors']` and `Successes` back to 0 partway through the run (`source/webERP/sql/updates/17.php:21-22`). This erases failures from earlier updates, so updates 25–35 pass their guard and record themselves as done. An upgrade from below 17 can show 0 errors on the result page and hide the earlier error messages, which are printed only when `Errors>0` (`source/webERP/Z_UpgradeDatabase.php:145-158`).
28	
29	- Update 17 rebuilds `gltotals` and calls `UpdateDBNo` with no guard. Update 20 then drops `chartdetails` and the `gltrans.posted` column whether or not that rebuild succeeded. If it failed, the old balance table is gone and the version number has moved on, leaving no GL totals source to recover from. Update 20 also checks `DB_error_no($Result)` against a variable its own helper calls never set (`source/webERP/sql/updates/17.php:10-90`, `source/webERP/sql/updates/20.php:1-19`).
30	
31	- Triggers keep `gltotals` in step with `gltrans`. Rows that predate them are not repaired by any area. `CreatePeriod` builds the SQL that seeds `gltotals` for a new period but never runs it, so a period's rows exist only after a `gltrans` insert fires the insert trigger (`source/webERP/includes/DateFunctions.php:1211-1225`). The update and delete triggers use a plain UPDATE and rely on that row already existing (`source/webERP/install/sql/triggers/gltrans_after_delete.sql:1-6`). Code that reads `gltotals` with an INNER JOIN, or expects one row per account and period as update 17 seeds, misses accounts in new periods.
32	
33	- The `gltotals` triggers are MySQL-only. The installer notes they will not work on Postgres and treats their failure as a warning (`source/webERP/includes/InstallFunctions.php:737-753`). All GL statements (`GLTrialBalance`, `GLBalanceSheet`, `GLProfit_Loss`) read `gltotals` (`source/webERP/GLTrialBalance.php:91-145`). A Postgres install, for which `ConnectDB_postgres` and `UpgradeDB_postgres` exist, therefore posts to `gltrans` but shows empty financial statements with no error. Whether Postgres is still a supported install target is unconfirmed.
34	
35	- Commits precede side effects such as email and file deletes. In the API, `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` runs before the commit, but when it rolls back the API code carries on. It updates `salesorders`, writes `debtortrans` and the tax rows outside a transaction, calls `DB_Txn_Commit`, and returns success with the invoice number. An unbalanced API invoice therefore leaves a customer invoice with no GL entries, and on the lines read the rollback error does not reach `$Errors` (`source/webERP/api/includes/api_salesorders.php:1377-1443`). When `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` corrects a rounding difference, it adjusts an arbitrary GL row. It takes the first row of `SELECT counterindex, MAX(amount) ... GROUP BY counterindex`, not the largest line, so corrections can land on a tax or freight line. Any copy of the function inherits this (`source/webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php:359-369`). Recurring auto-invoices commit the order before the invoice transaction and never check balance. A failed invoice is never retried.
36

## The areas

It leaves tables and config keys that every other area reads. The installer includes its `UpgradeDB_<DBType>` helpers. The reporting area runs the report builder.

- **Installer, seed data, schema, API, QA, MRP, petty cash, admin pages, tests and build tooling.** Builds a fresh database through the six-step wizard, seeds charts of accounts, menus and security, and provides the login/session bootstrap. It also holds the XML-RPC API, MRP, QA samples, the petty-cash cycle, CSV imports, settings pages, and the CI and release scripts. It hands the other areas their tables and sessions. Its API and petty-cash pages post into the same ledgers as the posting area. The `gltotals` triggers it installs are MySQL-only, and a trigger failure counts only as a warning (`source/webERP/includes/InstallFunctions.php:737-753`).

## Flows across areas

1. The session bootstrap (installer area) compares only `DBVersion` with `DBUpdateNumber` and redirects to the upgrade area. ## Conventions

  - Among the numbered updates, 0–16, 25–35 and 43 call `UpdateDBNo` only when `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors']` is 0. Updates 17–24 and 36–42 call it unconditionally (`source/webERP/includes/UpgradeDB_mariadb.php:751-757`, `source/webERP/sql/updates/42.php:1-11`). The newest file, 43, is guarded but 42 is not, so the next update copied from either one decides whether failures stop the version number.

  - `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` is called only by the API invoice and credit-note functions. No web posting page calls it (`source/webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php:346-373`, `source/webERP/api/includes/api_salesorders.php:1377-1443`).

An upgrade from below 17 can show 0 errors on the result page and hide the earlier error messages, which are printed only when `Errors>0` (`source/webERP/Z_UpgradeDatabase.php:145-158`).

# Task: notes on stock items

When implementing webERP and importing data from another system, ad hoc
item "notes" are often available and worth keeping. webERP has no item
notes feature; today people put such text in the item's long description.

Add the option to store zero to many notes about a stock item: a way to
add, view, edit and delete an item's notes, reachable from the item's page,
and a way to bring notes in when items are imported.

2	
3	Part of [webERP sales, purchasing, stock, work-order, GL and master-data pages](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-work-order-gl-and-master-data--151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.
4	
5	This topic holds webERP's one-off CSV import pages (chart of accounts, GL account groups and sections, GL transactions, fixed assets, part codes, price list, stock items, suppliers) and `StockCounts.php`. Each import page takes an uploaded CSV, validates it and writes to the database, either in one transaction or row by row through an API function. They call `GetNextTransNo` and `GetPeriod` (in includes), `InsertGLAccountGroup`, `InsertGLAccountSection`, `InsertStockItem`, and `includes/GLPostings.php`.
6	
7	## Contract
8	**In (all pages):** HTTP form posts with an uploaded CSV (comma-separated, header row first), plus a `gettemplate` GET flag on some pages.
9	
10	| Page | Upload field | Other inputs | Header (case-insensitive match) |
11	|---|---|---|---|
12	| `webERP/Z_ImportChartOfAccounts.php` | `ChartFile` | – | Account Code, Description, Account Group (3) |
13	| `webERP/Z_ImportFixedAssets.php` | `SelectedAssetFile` | `DateToEnter`, `FromUserID`, `ToUserID` | Description, LongDescription, AssetCategoryID, SerialNo, BarCode, AssetLocationCode, Cost, AccumDepn, DepnType, DepnRate, DatePurchased (11) |
14	| `webERP/Z_ImportGLAccountGroups.php` | `ImportFile` | `update` | Column names are free; the page uses them as array keys |
15	| `webERP/Z_ImportGLAccountSections.php` | `ImportFile` | `update` | Column names are free; the page uses them as array keys |

36	## Entry points and guards (in order)
37	No page shows a permission check.
38	
39	**Chart of accounts**

51	- Otherwise show the upload form with a date selector.
52	- `if count($HeaderRow) != count($FieldNames)` -> error, exit.
53	- `if header name mismatch` -> error, exit.
54	- `if row field count != 11` -> error, exit.
55	- Per-row checks that set `$InputError=true`; none of them stops the loop, so all errors are collected:
56	  - `strlen(Description)==0 or >50`
57	  - `!is_numeric(DepnRate)`
58	  - `DepnRate<0 or >100`
59	  - `!is_numeric(AccumDepn)`

64	  - `fixedassetcategories` has no row for the category
65	  - `fixedassetlocations` has no row for the location

68	- `if FromUserID==ToUserID` -> error, `$InputError=1`.
69	- `if $InputError == false` -> `GetNextTransNo(49)`, `GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate(DateToEnter))`, INSERT `fixedassets`.
70	  - If `DB_error_no()==0`: `DB_Last_Insert_ID('fixedassets','assetid')`, then two `fixedassettrans` INSERTs (`cost` and `depn`), then a success message.
71	
72	**GL account groups and sections**
73	- `if isset($_POST['update'])` -> process; otherwise show the form (the sections page also shows an info message).
74	- `if $FieldValues[0]!=''` -> build the array and call the Insert function.
75	- Groups page: `if $Answer[0]==0` -> success and `$successes++`; otherwise failure, list errors, `$failures++`.
76	- Sections page: same, with `$ErrorDescription` giving the error text.
77	
78	**GL transactions**
79	- `if isset($_FILES['userfile']) and name` -> process.
80	- If the first cell starts with the BOM `\xef\xbb\xbf`, strip it.
81	- `if count($HeadRow) != 6` -> error, exit.
82	- `if header name mismatch` -> error, exit.
83	- `GetNextTransNo($_POST['TransactionType'])`.
84	- SELECT the currency rate for `$_POST['Currency']`.
85	- `DB_Txn_Begin()`.
86	- Per row:
87	  - `if field count != target` -> error, exit.
88	  - `if COUNT(accountcode) in chartmaster == 0` -> `$InputError=1`.
89	  - `if !Is_date(row[0])` -> `$InputError=1`.
90	  - `GetPeriod(row[0])`.
91	  - `if isset($PreviousPeriod) and $PreviousPeriod != $Period` -> `$InputError=1`.
92	  - Amount is cast to float.
93	  - `if $InputError != 1` -> INSERT `gltrans`.
94	  - `if TransactionType != 0 AND IsBankAccount(row[1])` -> read the rate from currencies joined to bankaccounts, INSERT `banktrans` (banktranstype `__('Cheque')`).
95	  - Add the amount to `$TransactionTotal`.
96	  - `if $InputError==1` -> break.
97	- After the loop: `if $InputError != 1 and round($TransactionTotal,2) != 0` -> `$InputError=1`.
98	- Then rollback if `$InputError==1`, otherwise commit.

101	- `if isset($_POST['update'])` -> process; otherwise show the form.
102	- `if DB_num_rows(select * from locations)==0` -> error "No locations have been set up...".
103	- Per row: `if $FieldValues[0] != ''` -> map to `$ItemDetails`, call `InsertStockItem`.
104	  - `$Answer[0]==0` -> success row.
105	  - Otherwise failure row listing the errors.

110	- BOM, header count != 4, and header name mismatch each give an error and exit.
111	- Data row field count != 4 -> error, exit.

121	- Row field count != 18 -> error, exit.

123	  - StockID already in `stockmaster`.
124	  - Description empty or >50.
125	  - LongDescription empty.
126	  - StockID empty.

136	  - MBFlag in A, K, D, G with `Controlled==1`.
137	  - CategoryID empty.
138	  - ItemPDF empty.
139	- `if $InputError != 1 AND Serialised==1` -> DecimalPlaces set to 0.

141	- `if DB_error_no()==0` -> INSERT `locstock`; otherwise `$InputError=1`, print the error, break.
142	- Rollback if `$InputError==1`, otherwise commit.
143	
144	**Suppliers**
145	- `if isset($_FILES['userfile']) and name` -> process.
146	- `elseif gettemplate` -> CSV header only.
147	- Header count mismatch and header name mismatch give an error and exit.
148	- Row field count != `$FieldTarget` -> error, exit.

150	  - SuppName length 0 or >40.
151	  - SupplierID empty.
152	  - `ContainsIllegalCharacters(SupplierID)`.
153	  - Phone >25.
154	  - Fax >25.

161	- `SuppExists AND UpdateIfExists == 1` -> `$UpdatedNum++`, UPDATE suppliers.
162	  - `currcode` is only updated if `supptrans` has no rows for the supplier (`$SuppTrans==0`).

167	**StockCounts.php**
168	- If neither POST nor GET `Action` is set -> 'Enter'.
169	- If POST `Action` is set -> it overwrites GET.
170	- If GET `Action` is not 'View' or 'Enter' -> 'Enter'.
171	- If `gettemplate` is set, the page sends these headers:
172	  - Content-Type: application/force-download, application/octet-stream, application/download
173	  - Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=ImportTemplate.csv
174	  - Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary
175	- It then calls `ob_clean()`, outputs the header row, includes the footer and exits.
176	- Otherwise it calls `ob_end_flush()`.
177	- The source ends at an incomplete `if ($_GET['Action']=='Enter')`, so no Enter or View logic is shown.
178	
179	## Decisions
180	- Every transactional importer uses `$InputError==1` to choose rollback over commit. These are chart of accounts, fixed assets, GL transactions, price list, stocks and suppliers.
181	- Failure messages: "Failed on row N. Batch import … rolled back" (chart of accounts, fixed assets, suppliers, GL transactions).
182	- Part codes, GL groups and GL sections process each row independently. A failed row does not stop later rows, and there is no rollback.
183	- The Insert APIs apply their own validation (behaviour not in this topic).
184	- `Z_ImportSuppliers.php` with `UpdateIfExists != 1` counts existing suppliers as "Exist" and does not write them.
185	- `Z_ImportSuppliers.php` validates `$_POST['SuppName']`, `Phone` and similar, not the CSV row values (the condensation lists `$_POST` names; how row values map to them is not shown).
186	
187	## Order and failure
188	- A header or field-count error does `fclose` and `exit`.
189	  - Chart of accounts, GL transactions and stocks: this happens inside an open transaction or before commit. The condensations show no rollback call on that path (GL transactions notes the transaction is left open).
190	  - Fixed assets, price list and suppliers: whether the exit comes before or after `DB_Txn_Begin()` is not shown.
191	- GL transactions calls `GetNextTransNo` before `DB_Txn_Begin()`. Inside it:
192	  - SELECT … FOR UPDATE on `systypes`
193	  - UPDATE `typeno=typeno+1`
194	  - SELECT of the new `typeno`
195	- That increment is not in the import's transaction, so a rolled-back import still consumes a number.
196	- Fixed assets calls `GetNextTransNo(49)` and `GetPeriod` per valid asset (inside the transaction).
197	- `GetNextTransNo` errors are CRITICAL ERROR messages through `DB_query`'s `$ErrMsg`.
198	- `GetPeriod($TransDate,$UseProhibit=true)`:
199	  - It parses the date by separator `/`, `-` or `.`, and by `$_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']`.
200	  - If `ProhibitPostingsBefore` is a valid date, earlier dates are moved up to it.
201	  - If `periods` is empty, it inserts periods 0 and 1.
202	  - If the date has no period (`!PeriodExists`), it creates missing periods with `CreatePeriod` after the last period or before the first, and then returns the period number.
203	  - So importing dates far out creates `periods` rows.
204	- The `GetPeriod` body past line 1338 was not read.
205	- In the GL transactions import, `gltrans` rows are skipped once `$InputError` is set, but the rollback undoes earlier inserts.
206	- The chart of accounts import ends with `fclose` and `include('includes/GLPostings.php')` (behaviour not in this topic). That include is reported as "bug: file not found" in a comment.
207	- No page handles `fopen` or `fgetcsv` failure.
208	
209	## Connections
210	- `webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php` `GetNextTransNo($TransType)`: returns the incremented `systypes.typeno`. Called by the GL transactions import (type from `$_POST['TransactionType']`) and the fixed assets import (type 49).
211	- `webERP/includes/DateFunctions.php` `GetPeriod`: returns the period number. Called by the GL transactions import and the fixed assets import.
212	- Tables read: `accountgroups`, `fixedassetcategories`, `fixedassetlocations`, `chartmaster`, `currencies`, `bankaccounts`, `stockmaster`, `salestypes`, `locations`, `supptrans`, `suppliers`.
213	- Tables written: see the Contract table.
214	- `$_SESSION['FormID']` is embedded in forms.
215	- `$_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']` and `ProhibitPostingsBefore` are read by `GetPeriod` and the date checks.
216	- The part-code, group and section pages hand rows to the Insert API functions.
217	
218	## Conclusions
219	- No page checks a permission, so any user who can reach it can bulk-write accounts, assets, prices, stock and suppliers.
220	- `MAX_FILE_SIZE=1000000` is only a hidden form field, and no PHP code checks it.
221	- Price list: there is no duplicate check, and `UPDATE prices` closes open prices for the matching stockid and typeabbrev, so the old rows get `enddate=StartDate`. A row whose stock id exists but whose price is empty is inserted with price 0.
222	- Importing the same chart of accounts file twice: the second INSERT depends on the schema's key and may fail, which rolls the batch back; no pre-check exists. Stocks reject existing StockIDs, so a second run fails with "already exists". Suppliers re-run is idempotent when `UpdateIfExists` is 0 and refreshes the data when it is 1. Part codes, groups and sections depend on the Insert functions.
223	- GL transactions: all rows must fall in one period (`PreviousPeriod != Period` -> error) and must sum to zero after rounding to 2 decimals. Note that `GetPeriod` may move prohibited-period dates forward, so dates before `ProhibitPostingsBefore` are accepted and mapped to the same period. For TransactionType 0, no `banktrans` rows are written. For non-zero types, only rows whose account is a bank account write `banktrans`.
224	- Fixed assets: `DepnType` is stored as 1 for DV and 0 for SL. One asset gets two `fixedassettrans` rows. The "FromUserID == ToUserID" check does not relate to any CSV field and rejects the batch, so it depends on form fields not described. A bad row does not stop validation, so the rollback message appears only after the whole file has been checked.
225	- Fixed asset error text says "more than 3 characters" while the code checks only `strlen==0` or `>50`.
226	- Stocks: the `locstock` rows are created for every location. `ItemPDF` has to hold a filename or `none`. Stocks does not check that `CategoryID`, `TaxCat` or `MBFlag` references exist beyond the checks listed.
227	- Suppliers does not check that `CurrCode`, `SupplierType`, `PaymentTerms`, `TaxGroup` or `FactorID` exist.
228	- Suppliers does not check latitude or longitude.
229	- `StockCounts.php` has no live Enter or View body in the source shown, so nothing about saving counts follows from it. Its import template is only a download; no importer reading `StockCode, QtyCounted, Reference` is in this topic.
230	- No sender of these forms was found other than the pages' own forms. The part-code and GL pages hand rows to the Insert API functions, whose acceptance of the array keys (taken from the CSV headers) is not checked here.
231	
232	## Hazards
233	- Rows are inserted with unescaped CSV values in SQL (no injection protection shown).
234	- Part codes, groups and sections are partially applied after failures, because there is no rollback.
235	- Error exits for column errors during open transactions can leave them open (GL transactions explicitly).
236	- A rolled-back GL import or fixed asset import still increments `systypes.typeno`.
237	- `GetPeriod` creates `periods` rows as a side effect for far-off dates.
238	- The price list import can create several active prices for one stock, sales type and currency.
239	- The supplier page's `UpdateIfExists` update path can silently leave `currcode` unchanged.
240	
241	## Open first
242	- `webERP/Z_ImportGLTransactions.php`: the most complex flow (period, balance, bank transactions).
243	- `webERP/Z_ImportStocks.php`: the longest validation list.
244	- `webERP/Z_ImportSuppliers.php`: insert/update logic.
245	- `webERP/Z_ImportFixedAssets.php`: validation and asset records.
246	- `webERP/Z_ImportPriceList.php`, `webERP/Z_ImportChartOfAccounts.php`: transactional imports.
247	- `webERP/StockCounts.php`: template download.
248

254	  - this topic took from `webERP/includes/DateFunctions.php`: `GetPeriod` parses the date, applies `ProhibitPostingsBefore`, inserts first periods if none exist, and creates missing periods via `CreatePeriod`; `PeriodExists` checks `periods`.
255	  - this topic took from `webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php`: `GetNextTransNo` does SELECT typeno FROM systypes FOR UPDATE, UPDATE typeno=typeno+1, SELECT typeno, returns it, with CRITICAL ERROR messages.
256	- [Inventory and stock reports (webERP): planning, valuation, quantities…](weberp-reporting-and-document-output-153/inventory-and-stock-reports-weberp-planning-valuation-quanti-115/brief.md)
257	  - it took from this topic's `webERP/StockCounts.php`: references the stock check pages (matched by grep; not read in detail).
258

# webERP Z_Import* utilities and StockCounts: CSV bulk-import pages and the stock-count entry page

Part of [webERP sales, purchasing, stock, work-order, GL and master-data pages](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-work-order-gl-and-master-data--151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

This topic holds webERP's one-off CSV import pages (chart of accounts, GL account groups and sections, GL transactions, fixed assets, part codes, price list, stock items, suppliers) and `StockCounts.php`. Each import page takes an uploaded CSV, validates it and writes to the database, either in one transaction or row by row through an API function. They call `GetNextTransNo` and `GetPeriod` (in includes), `InsertGLAccountGroup`, `InsertGLAccountSection`, `InsertStockItem`, and `includes/GLPostings.php`.

## Contract
**In (all pages):** HTTP form posts with an uploaded CSV (comma-separated, header row first), plus a `gettemplate` GET flag on some pages.

| Page | Upload field | Other inputs | Header (case-insensitive match) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `webERP/Z_ImportChartOfAccounts.php` | `ChartFile` | – | Account Code, Description, Account Group (3) |
| `webERP/Z_ImportFixedAssets.php` | `SelectedAssetFile` | `DateToEnter`, `FromUserID`, `ToUserID` | Description, LongDescription, AssetCategoryID, SerialNo, BarCode, AssetLocationCode, Cost, AccumDepn, DepnType, DepnRate, DatePurchased (11) |
| `webERP/Z_ImportGLAccountGroups.php` | `ImportFile` | `update` | Column names are free; the page uses them as array keys |
| `webERP/Z_ImportGLAccountSections.php` | `ImportFile` | `update` | Column names are free; the page uses them as array keys |
| `webERP/Z_ImportGLTransactions.php` | `userfile` | `TransactionType`, `Currency` | Date, Account, ChequeNo, Amount, Narrative, Tag (6) |
| `webERP/Z_ImportPartCodes.php` | `ImportFile` | `update` | Column names are free; the page uses them as array keys |
| `webERP/Z_ImportPriceList.php` | `PriceListFile` | `StartDate` | StockID, SalesType, CurrencyCode, Price (4) |
| `webERP/Z_ImportStocks.php` | `userfile` | – | StockID, Description, LongDescription, CategoryID, Units, MBFlag, EOQ, Discontinued, Controlled, Serialised, Perishable, Volume, grossweight, BarCode, DiscountCategory, TaxCat, DecimalPlaces, ItemPDF (18) |
| `webERP/Z_ImportSuppliers.php` | `userfile` | `UpdateIfExists` (0/1) | SupplierID, SuppName, Address1-6, Phone, Fax, Email, SupplierType, CurrCode, SupplierSince, PaymentTerms, BankPartics, BankRef, BankAct, Remittance, TaxGroup, FactorID, latitude, longitude, TaxRef |

**Out:** DB writes and `prnMsg` or HTML output.

| Page | Tables written | How |
|---|---|---|
| Chart of accounts | `chartmaster` (accountcode, accountname, group_) | One transaction, then `includes/GLPostings.php` |
| Fixed assets | `fixedassets`, `fixedassettrans` | `fixedassettrans` gets two rows per asset, types `cost` and `depn` |
| GL transactions | `gltrans`, `banktrans` | One transaction |
| Price list | `prices` | UPDATE closes open prices, then INSERT |
| Stocks | `stockmaster`, `locstock` | `locstock` is INSERT…SELECT from `locations` |
| Suppliers | `suppliers` | INSERT or UPDATE |
| GL account groups, GL account sections, part codes | – | Through `InsertGLAccountGroup($AccountGroupDetails,'','')`, `InsertGLAccountSection($AccountSectionDetails,'','')` and `InsertStockItem($ItemDetails,'','')`. A return of `$Answer[0]==0` means success (behaviour not in this topic) |

`webERP/StockCounts.php`: GET/POST `Action` ('View' or 'Enter'), GET `gettemplate`, and `$_SESSION['FormID']` in the form. The template CSV header is StockCode, QtyCounted, Reference.

## Entry points and guards (in order)
No page shows a permission check.

**Chart of accounts**
- `if isset($_FILES['ChartFile']) and name` -> process the file; otherwise show the form.
- `if count($HeadRow) != 3` -> error, fclose, exit.
- `if header name mismatch` -> error, exit.
- `if count($MyRow) != 3` -> error, exit.
- `if COUNT(groupname) in accountgroups == 0` -> `$InputError=1`.
- `if $InputError != 1` -> INSERT into chartmaster.
- `if $InputError==1` -> break.

**Fixed assets**
- `if isset($_FILES['SelectedAssetFile']['name'])` -> process the file.
- `elseif gettemplate` -> output the CSV header.
- Otherwise show the upload form with a date selector.
- `if count($HeaderRow) != count($FieldNames)` -> error, exit.
- `if header name mismatch` -> error, exit.
- `if row field count != 11` -> error, exit.
- Per-row checks that set `$InputError=true`; none of them stops the loop, so all errors are collected:
  - `strlen(Description)==0 or >50`
  - `!is_numeric(DepnRate)`
  - `DepnRate<0 or >100`
  - `!is_numeric(AccumDepn)`
  - `AccumDepn<0`
  - `!is_numeric(Cost)`
  - `Cost<=0`
  - `DepnType !='SL' AND !='DV'`
  - `fixedassetcategories` has no row for the category
  - `fixedassetlocations` has no row for the location
  - `!Is_Date(DatePurchased)`
- `DepnType` 'DV' becomes 1, otherwise 0.
- `if FromUserID==ToUserID` -> error, `$InputError=1`.
- `if $InputError == false` -> `GetNextTransNo(49)`, `GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate(DateToEnter))`, INSERT `fixedassets`.
  - If `DB_error_no()==0`: `DB_Last_Insert_ID('fixedassets','assetid')`, then two `fixedassettrans` INSERTs (`cost` and `depn`), then a success message.

**GL account groups and sections**
- `if isset($_POST['update'])` -> process; otherwise show the form (the sections page also shows an info message).
- `if $FieldValues[0]!=''` -> build the array and call the Insert function.
- Groups page: `if $Answer[0]==0` -> success and `$successes++`; otherwise failure, list errors, `$failures++`.
- Sections page: same, with `$ErrorDescription` giving the error text.

**GL transactions**
- `if isset($_FILES['userfile']) and name` -> process.
- If the first cell starts with the BOM `\xef\xbb\xbf`, strip it.
- `if count($HeadRow) != 6` -> error, exit.
- `if header name mismatch` -> error, exit.
- `GetNextTransNo($_POST['TransactionType'])`.
- SELECT the currency rate for `$_POST['Currency']`.
- `DB_Txn_Begin()`.
- Per row:
  - `if field count != target` -> error, exit.
  - `if COUNT(accountcode) in chartmaster == 0` -> `$InputError=1`.
  - `if !Is_date(row[0])` -> `$InputError=1`.
  - `GetPeriod(row[0])`.
  - `if isset($PreviousPeriod) and $PreviousPeriod != $Period` -> `$InputError=1`.
  - Amount is cast to float.
  - `if $InputError != 1` -> INSERT `gltrans`.

## Decisions
- Every transactional importer uses `$InputError==1` to choose rollback over commit. These are chart of accounts, fixed assets, GL transactions, price list, stocks and suppliers.
- Failure messages: "Failed on row N. Batch import … rolled back" (chart of accounts, fixed assets, suppliers, GL transactions).
- Part codes, GL groups and GL sections process each row independently. A failed row does not stop later rows, and there is no rollback.
- The Insert APIs apply their own validation (behaviour not in this topic).
- `Z_ImportSuppliers.php` with `UpdateIfExists != 1` counts existing suppliers as "Exist" and does not write them.
- `Z_ImportSuppliers.php` validates `$_POST['SuppName']`, `Phone` and similar, not the CSV row values (the condensation lists `$_POST` names; how row values map to them is not shown).

## Order and failure
- A header or field-count error does `fclose` and `exit`.
  - Chart of accounts, GL transactions and stocks: this happens inside an open transaction or before commit. The condensations show no rollback call on that path (GL transactions notes the transaction is left open).
  - Fixed assets, price list and suppliers: whether the exit comes before or after `DB_Txn_Begin()` is not shown.
- GL transactions calls `GetNextTransNo` before `DB_Txn_Begin()`. Inside it:
  - SELECT … FOR UPDATE on `systypes`
  - UPDATE `typeno=typeno+1`
  - SELECT of the new `typeno`
- That increment is not in the import's transaction, so a rolled-back import still consumes a number.
- Fixed assets calls `GetNextTransNo(49)` and `GetPeriod` per valid asset (inside the transaction).
- `GetNextTransNo` errors are CRITICAL ERROR messages through `DB_query`'s `$ErrMsg`.
- `GetPeriod($TransDate,$UseProhibit=true)`:
  - It parses the date by separator `/`, `-` or `.`, and by `$_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']`.
  - If `ProhibitPostingsBefore` is a valid date, earlier dates are moved up to it.
  - If `periods` is empty, it inserts periods 0 and 1.
  - If the date has no period (`!PeriodExists`), it creates missing periods with `CreatePeriod` after the last period or before the first, and then returns the period number.
  - So importing dates far out creates `periods` rows.
- The `GetPeriod` body past line 1338 was not read.
- In the GL transactions import, `gltrans` rows are skipped once `$InputError` is set, but the rollback undoes earlier inserts.
- The chart of accounts import ends with `fclose` and `include('includes/GLPostings.php')` (behaviour not in this topic). That include is reported as "bug: file not found" in a comment.
- No page handles `fopen` or `fgetcsv` failure.

## Connections
- `webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php` `GetNextTransNo($TransType)`: returns the incremented `systypes.typeno`. Called by the GL transactions import (type from `$_POST['TransactionType']`) and the fixed assets import (type 49).
- `webERP/includes/DateFunctions.php` `GetPeriod`: returns the period number. Called by the GL transactions import and the fixed assets import.
- Tables read: `accountgroups`, `fixedassetcategories`, `fixedassetlocations`, `chartmaster`, `currencies`, `bankaccounts`, `stockmaster`, `salestypes`, `locations`, `supptrans`, `suppliers`.
- Tables written: see the Contract table.
- `$_SESSION['FormID']` is embedded in forms.
- `$_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']` and `ProhibitPostingsBefore` are read by `GetPeriod` and the date checks.
- The part-code, group and section pages hand rows to the Insert API functions.

## Conclusions
- No page checks a permission, so any user who can reach it can bulk-write accounts, assets, prices, stock and suppliers.
- `MAX_FILE_SIZE=1000000` is only a hidden form field, and no PHP code checks it.
- Price list: there is no duplicate check, and `UPDATE prices` closes open prices for the matching stockid and typeabbrev, so the old rows get `enddate=StartDate`. A row whose stock id exists but whose price is empty is inserted with price 0.
- Importing the same chart of accounts file twice: the second INSERT depends on the schema's key and may fail, which rolls the batch back; no pre-check exists. Stocks reject existing StockIDs, so a second run fails with "already exists". Suppliers re-run is idempotent when `UpdateIfExists` is 0 and refreshes the data when it is 1. Part codes, groups and sections depend on the Insert functions.
- GL transactions: all rows must fall in one period (`PreviousPeriod != Period` -> error) and must sum to zero after rounding to 2 decimals. Note that `GetPeriod` may move prohibited-period dates forward, so dates before `ProhibitPostingsBefore` are accepted and mapped to the same period. For TransactionType 0, no `banktrans` rows are written. For non-zero types, only rows whose account is a bank account write `banktrans`.
- Fixed assets: `DepnType` is stored as 1 for DV and 0 for SL. One asset gets two `fixedassettrans` rows. The "FromUserID == ToUserID" check does not relate to any CSV field and rejects the batch, so it depends on form fields not described. A bad row does not stop validation, so the rollback message appears only after the whole file has been checked.
- Fixed asset error text says "more than 3 characters" while the code checks only `strlen==0` or `>50`.
- Stocks: the `locstock` rows are created for every location. `ItemPDF` has to hold a filename or `none`. Stocks does not check that `CategoryID`, `TaxCat` or `MBFlag` references exist beyond the checks listed.
- Suppliers does not check that `CurrCode`, `SupplierType`, `PaymentTerms`, `TaxGroup` or `FactorID` exist.
- Suppliers does not check latitude or longitude.
- `StockCounts.php` has no live Enter or View body in the source shown, so nothing about saving counts follows from it. Its import template is only a download; no importer reading `StockCode, QtyCounted, Reference` is in this topic.
- No sender of these forms was found other than the pages' own forms. The part-code and GL pages hand rows to the Insert API functions, whose acceptance of the array keys (taken from the CSV headers) is not checked here.

## Hazards
- Rows are inserted with unescaped CSV values in SQL (no injection protection shown).
- Part codes, groups and sections are partially applied after failures, because there is no rollback.
- Error exits for column errors during open transactions can leave them open (GL transactions explicitly).
- A rolled-back GL import or fixed asset import still increments `systypes.typeno`.
- `GetPeriod` creates `periods` rows as a side effect for far-off dates.
- The price list import can create several active prices for one stock, sales type and currency.
- The supplier page's `UpdateIfExists` update path can silently leave `currcode` unchanged.

## Open first
- `webERP/Z_ImportGLTransactions.php`: the most complex flow (period, balance, bank transactions).
- `webERP/Z_ImportStocks.php`: the longest validation list.
- `webERP/Z_ImportSuppliers.php`: insert/update logic.
- `webERP/Z_ImportFixedAssets.php`: validation and asset records.
- `webERP/Z_ImportPriceList.php`, `webERP/Z_ImportChartOfAccounts.php`: transactional imports.
- `webERP/StockCounts.php`: template download.

177	- Both Z_ scripts refuse when the new code already exists.

180	- **Update:** everything is inside one transaction. Errors from `DB_query` are re-raised to the caller. No explicit rollback is shown, and `DB_Txn_Commit` follows the later steps.
181	- **Insert:** the transaction wraps all inserts. If the `stockmaster` INSERT fails (`DB_error_no != 0`), the remaining inserts are skipped. No explicit rollback is shown.

196	- Stocks.php posts the stock journal using `UnitCost * StockQtyRow[0]`. This only happens if the stock account changed with `gllink_stock == 1`. `gltrans` rows are not checked against the GL accounts and no balance check is made, but the two rows carry the same amount in opposite directions.

# webERP stock item maintenance: Stocks.php plus the Z_ChangeStockCategory.php and Z_ChangeStockCode.php utilities

Part of [webERP sales, purchasing, stock, work-order, GL and master-data pages](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-work-order-gl-and-master-data--151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

Stocks.php is the item create, update and delete page, with navigation, multilingual descriptions, category properties and image upload. The two Z_ utilities rename a stock category code or an item code across the related tables. All of it reads and writes `stockmaster` and the tables around it directly, and it takes transaction numbers from `GetNextTransNo`.

## Contract
- **In:**
  - POST/GET form fields: `StockID` (trimmed, uppercased), `NextItem`, `PreviousItem`, `UpdateCategories`, `New`, `submit`, `delete`, `ClearImage`, `ItemPicture` (file).
  - Item fields: `Description`, `LongDescription`, `Units`, `BarCode`, `Volume`, `GrossWeight`, `NetWeight`, `EOQ`, `Controlled`, `Serialised`, `Perishable`, `NextSerialNo`, `MBFlag`, `CategoryID`, `Pansize`, `ShrinkFactor`, `Discontinued`, `DiscountCategory`, `TaxCat`, `DecimalPlaces`.
  - Language fields: `Description_<LanguageId>`, `LongDescription_<LanguageId>`.
  - Property fields: `PropertyCounter`, `PropID<i>`, `PropNumeric<i>`, `PropType<i>`, `PropValue<i>`, `PropMin<i>`, `PropMax<i>`.
  - Z_ChangeStockCategory.php: `ProcessStockChange`, `OldStockCategory`, `NewStockCategory`.
  - Z_ChangeStockCode.php: `OldStockID`, `NewStockID` (uppercased).
  - Session values: `ItemDescriptionLanguages` (comma-separated), `MaxImageSize` (KB), `part_pics_dir`, `CompanyRecord['gllink_stock']`, `DefaultDateFormat`, `DefaultTaxCategory`, `SelectedStockItem`.
- **Out, written tables:**
  - `stockmaster`
  - `stockdescriptiontranslations`
  - `stockitemproperties`
  - `locstock`
  - `gltrans` (type 0 journals)
  - `stockcategory`
  - `stockcatproperties`
  - `salesanalysis`
  - `internalstockcatrole`
  - about 35 item-keyed tables for the item-code rename (listed under Z_ChangeStockCode.php below)
- **Out, files:** item images at `part_pics_dir/<StockID>.<png|jpg|jpeg>`.
- **Out, delete:** rows deleted from `locstock`, `prices`, `purchdata`, `bom` (parent), `stockitemproperties`, `stockdescriptiontranslations` and `stockmaster`.

## Entry points

### Stocks.php, request start
No permission check and no FormID check are shown.
1. `if GET/POST StockID set -> trim, uppercase to $StockID`, else `$StockID = ''`.
2. `if NextItem -> SELECT stockmaster WHERE stockid > $StockID ORDER ASC LIMIT 1`. A hit sets `$StockID` to it; no hit sets `$HasNext = false`. The `Description_*` POST values are unset.
3. `if PreviousItem -> stockid < $StockID ORDER DESC LIMIT 1`. A hit sets `$StockID` to it; no hit sets `$HasPrev = false`. The `Description_*` POST values are unset.
4. `if $StockID != '' and UpdateCategories not set -> count stockmaster WHERE stockid=$StockID`. A count of 0 sets `$New = 1`, otherwise `$New = 0`.
5. `if POST New set -> $New = $_POST['New']`.

### Stocks.php, image upload
Runs when `ItemPicture` name is not empty.
- `$ImgExt` comes from the file name. `$FileName = part_pics_dir/StockID.ImgExt`. `$UploadTheFile = 'Yes'` to start.
- `$UploadTheFile = 'No'` (with a warning) for each of these:
  - `ImgExt not in (png, jpg, jpeg)`
  - `size > MaxImageSize*1024`
  - `type == 'text/plain'`
  - `error == 6`
  - `not is_writable(part_pics_dir)`
- Existing `StockID.png`, `StockID.jpg` and `StockID.jpeg` files are unlinked first. If an unlink fails, an error is shown and `$UploadTheFile = 'No'`.
- `if $UploadTheFile == 'Yes' -> move_uploaded_file`. The result message is a link on success, or 'Something is wrong with uploading' on failure.

### Stocks.php, submit validation
Each failure sets `$InputError = 1`, shows an error and records the field in `$Errors`. All checks run (no early exit).
1. `!isset(Description) or len > 50 or len == 0` -> Description.
2. `len(LongDescription) == 0` -> LongDescription.
3. `len(StockID) == 0` -> StockID.
4. `ContainsIllegalCharacters(StockID) or strpos(StockID,' ')` -> StockID, and `$StockID = ''`.
5. `len(Units) > 20` -> Units.
6. `len(BarCode) > 20` -> BarCode.
7. Volume, GrossWeight, NetWeight and EOQ: `!is_numeric(filter_number_format(x))` or `< 0` -> that field.
8. `Controlled == 0 and Serialised == 1` -> Serialised.
9. `NextSerialNo != 0 and Serialised == 0` -> NextSerialNo.
10. `NextSerialNo != 0 and MBFlag != 'M'` -> NextSerialNo.
11. `MBFlag in (A, K, D, G) and Controlled == 1` -> Controlled.
12. `trim(CategoryID) == ''` -> CategoryID.
13. Pansize and ShrinkFactor: `!is_numeric(filter_number_format(x))` -> that field.
- `if Serialised == 1 -> DecimalPlaces = 0`.

### Stocks.php, extra checks when `$New == 0`
The check on `$New` is partly off-screen. The checks below are shown. Each sets `InputError=1`.
- `OldMBFlag != MBFlag and OldMBFlag in [M,B] and MBFlag in [A,K,D,G]` combined with:
  - `StockQtyRow[0] != 0 and OldMBFlag != G` -> refused, stock on hand.
  - `Controlled == 1` -> refused, lot controlled.
- `MBFlag == K` and open sales order lines (`stkcode=StockID AND completed=0` and `quantity-qtyinvoiced != 0`) -> refused.
- `MBFlag in [K,A,D]` and open purchase order lines -> refused. The lines are those with `purchorderdetails.completed=0`, `purchorders.status not in [Cancelled, Completed, Rejected]` and `quantityord-quantityrecd != 0`.
- `OldMBFlag in [M,K,A,G] and MBFlag in [B,D]` and a BOM with `parent=StockID` -> refused.
- `OldMBFlag in [M,B,D,G] and MBFlag in [A,K]` and a BOM with `component=StockID` -> refused.
- `OldControlled != Controlled and StockQtyRow[0] != 0` -> refused.
- `OldSerialised != Serialised and StockQtyRow[0] != 0` -> refused.
- Property loop `i < PropertyCounter`: `PropNumeric[i]==1 and (value < PropMin[i] or value > PropMax[i])` -> refused.

### Stocks.php, update (`$InputError == 0`, existing item)
1. `DB_Txn_Begin`.
2. UPDATE `stockmaster` (numeric fields go through `filter_number_format`).
3. `if count(languages) > 0` -> per language, DELETE then INSERT in `stockdescriptiontranslations`.
4. `if OldDescription != Description or OldLongDescription != LongDescription -> UPDATE stockdescriptiontranslations SET needsrevision='0' WHERE stockid`. This applies to all of the item's translations.
5. DELETE `stockitemproperties`, then INSERT per property. `PropType==2` becomes 1 if the value is 'on', otherwise 0. `PropNumeric==1` goes through `filter_number_format`.
6. `if OldStockAccount != NewStockAct and gllink_stock == 1` -> `GetNextTransNo(0)` for the journal number. Two `gltrans` type 0 rows follow: debit `NewStockAct` and credit `OldStockAccount`, amount `UnitCost * StockQtyRow[0]`.
7. `if OldWIPAccount != NewWIPAct and gllink_stock == 1` -> sum open work order WIP (`workorders.closed=0`), per row `costissued - costrecd`. `if WIPValue != 0` -> `GetNextTransNo(0)`, then two type 0 rows: debit `NewWIPAct`, credit `OldWIPAccount`.
8. `DB_Txn_Commit`, then success message.

### Stocks.php, insert (new item)
- `if DB_num_rows(SELECT stockid WHERE stockid=...) == 1 -> InputError=1, Errors[]='StockID'`, with a duplicate-code message.
- Otherwise: `DB_Txn_Begin`, INSERT `stockmaster`.
- `if DB_error_no()==0`:
  - INSERT `stockdescriptiontranslations` per language, only if there are languages.
  - INSERT `stockitemproperties` per property.
  - `INSERT INTO locstock SELECT locations.loccode, StockID FROM locations`.
  - `DB_Txn_Commit`.
  - `if DB_error_no()==0` -> unset the POST fields and set `$New=1`.

### Stocks.php, delete
Runs when `POST delete` is set and `mb_strlen > 1`. `$CancelDelete = 1` with a warning (and a count) if any of these holds:
- `stockmoves` count > 0 for the item.
- `bom` with `component=StockID` > 0.
- `salesorderdetails` with `stkcode` > 0.
- `salesanalysis` > 0.
- `purchorderdetails` with `itemcode` > 0.
- `GetQuantityOnHand(StockID,'ALL') != 0`.
- `offers` count != 0.
- `tenderitems` count != 0.

If `$CancelDelete == 0`:
1. `DB_Txn_Begin`.
2. DELETE from `locstock`, `prices`, `purchdata`, `bom` (parent), `stockitemproperties`, `stockdescriptiontranslations` and `stockmaster`, in that order.
3. `DB_Txn_Commit`, then success message.
4. Unset the POST fields, `$_SESSION['SelectedStockItem']` and `$StockID`; `$New = 1`.

### Stocks.php, form display
- `if StockID unset/'' or UpdateCategories set` -> blank or new form.
- `elseif UpdateCategories unset and InputError != 1` -> load `stockmaster` and `stockdescriptiontranslations` into the form.
- `else` -> keep the posted values.
- Defaults:
  - EOQ, Volume, GrossWeight, NetWeight, Controlled, Pansize, ShrinkFactor, NextSerialNo, DecimalPlaces, Discontinued -> 0.
  - `Serialised` -> 0 if empty or `Controlled == 0`.
  - `Units` -> 'each'.
  - `TaxCat` -> `$_SESSION['DefaultTaxCategory']`.
- `MBFlag` select:
  - Pre-selected only on A (Assembly), D (Service/Labour) and when unset.
  - Kit, Manufactured, Phantom and Purchased are each selected when unset or equal to their own flag. Phantom and Purchased also select on ''.
- `NextSerialNo` is shown only if `Serialised == 1 and MBFlag == 'M'`, otherwise a hidden 0.
- `if ClearImage` -> unlink the png, jpg and jpeg files. `if is_file` still true -> error 'You do not have access to delete this item image file'.
- `if New == 1` -> editable StockID and a `submit` 'Insert New Item' button.
- `if New != 1` -> 'Update' and 'Delete This Item' buttons. Delete has a JS confirm.
- Previous/Next buttons show if `StockID != '' and InputError == 0`.
- Property inputs come from `stockcatproperties WHERE categoryid=CategoryID AND reqatsalesorder=0`. `controltype` 0 is a textbox (numeric gets min/max hidden inputs), 1 is a select (defaultvalue split by comma), 2 is a checkbox. Values come from `stockitemproperties` when `StockID` is set.

### Z_ChangeStockCategory.php (`if isset(ProcessStockChange)`)
Each check below ends the run with an error:
- `old category not in stockcategory` (0 rows).
- `ContainsIllegalCharacters(NewStockCategory)`.
- `NewStockCategory == ''`.
- `new category already exists` (rows != 0).

Then:
1. `DB_Txn_Begin`.
2. INSERT a copy of the old `stockcategory` row under the new id.
3. UPDATE `stockcatproperties.categoryid`.
4. UPDATE `stockmaster.categoryid`.
5. UPDATE `salesanalysis.stkcategory`.
6. UPDATE `internalstockcatrole.categoryid`.
7. `SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1`.
8. `DB_Txn_Commit`.
9. DELETE the old `stockcategory` row, outside the transaction.

### Z_ChangeStockCode.php
Each check sets `$InputError = 1`:
- `old code not in stockmaster`.
- `ContainsIllegalCharacters(NewStockID)`.
- `NewStockID == ''`.
- `new code already exists`.

If `InputError == 0`:
1. `DB_IgnoreForeignKeys`, `DB_Txn_Begin`.
2. INSERT a new `stockmaster` row.
3. `ChangeFieldInTable` over `locstock`, `stockmoves`, `loctransfers`, `mrpdemands`, `mrpplannedorders` (if it exists), `mrprequirements` (if it exists), `mrpsupplies` (if it exists), `salesanalysis`, `orderdeliverydifferenceslog`, `prices`, `salesorderdetails`, `purchorderdetails`, `purchdata`, `shipmentcharges`, `stockcheckfreeze`, `stockcounts`, `grns`, `contractbom`, `bom` (component and parent), `stockrequestitems`, `stockdescriptiontranslations`, `custitem`, `pricematrix`, `pickreqdetails`, `stockitemproperties`, `worequirements` (stockid and parentstockid), `woitems`, `salescatprod`, `stockserialitems`, `stockserialmoves`, `offers`, `tenderitems`, `prodspecs`, `qasamples`. The condensation says 24 calls but lists more tables.
4. For each of png, jpg and jpeg: rename the image file, or report 'failed' or 'no image to rename'.
5. `DB_ReinstateForeignKeys`, `DB_Txn_Commit`.
6. DELETE the old `stockmaster` row.
7. If `$_SESSION['SelectedStockItem'] == OldStockID`, set it to `NewStockID`.

## Decisions
- `Stocks.php` GL journal on account change: the stock account journal is only posted when `gllink_stock == 1`. The WIP journal is also skipped when the net WIP value is 0.
- `Stocks.php` MBFlag change (rules above): `stock on hand` blocks M/B to A/K/D/G unless the old flag was G.
- `Stocks.php` delete: a `stockmaster` row is only removed when there are no movements, BOM component uses, sales order lines, sales analysis rows, purchase order lines, stock on hand, offers or tenders for the item.
- Because the delete guard has no check on `prices`, `purchdata` or `locstock`, those rows are deleted along with the item.
- Both Z_ scripts refuse when the new code already exists.

- **Insert:** the transaction wraps all inserts. If the `stockmaster` INSERT fails (`DB_error_no != 0`), the remaining inserts are skipped. No explicit rollback is shown.
- **Delete:** the queries are inside a transaction. No check of per-query success before commit is shown.
- **Z_ChangeStockCategory:** the old-category DELETE is outside the transaction, after commit. If it fails, both category rows exist. The message for each step is passed to `DB_query` (with the transaction flag `true`).
- **Z_ChangeStockCode:** the old `stockmaster` row is deleted after commit. A failed `ChangeFieldInTable` or image rename is not handled; the rename is only reported in the output.
- **GetNextTransNo:** it runs `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`, `UPDATE systypes SET typeno = typeno + 1`, then re-SELECTs `typeno` and returns it. Failures show a 'CRITICAL ERROR' message through `DB_query`. - No loops poll or retry.

## Connections

- **`GetQuantityOnHand($StockID,'ALL')`** (behaviour not in this topic): used by the delete guard.
- **Helper functions** (behaviour not in this topic): `ContainsIllegalCharacters`, `filter_number_format`, `locale_number_format`, `GetImageLink`, `ChangeFieldInTable`, `DB_IgnoreForeignKeys`, `DB_ReinstateForeignKeys`.
- **Shared tables:** `stockmaster`, `stockcategory`, `stockcatproperties`, `locstock`, `locations`, `gltrans`, `systypes`, `workorders`, `woitems`, `salesorderdetails`, `purchorderdetails`, `purchorders`, `bom` and the other tables named above.
- **Session:** `$_SESSION['SelectedStockItem']` is shared with the other stock pages. It is unset on delete and updated on code rename.

## Conclusions

- No explicit rollback for any failed transaction step.

They are checked against `$_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']` as described under Decisions. ### Z_ItemsWithoutPicture.php - One query: `stockmaster JOIN stockcategory WHERE discontinued=0 AND stocktype != 'D' ORDER BY categorydescription, stockid`. ## Decisions ### PO_SelectPurchOrder.php Status criteria: - `!isset($_POST['Status']) OR == 'Pending_Authorised_Completed'` -> status in Pending, Authorised, Printed, Completed. - `Authorised` -> status in Authorised, Printed. - `Pending` -> status = Pending. - `Rejected` -> status = Rejected. - `Cancelled` -> status = Cancelled. - `Completed` -> status = Completed. - Rejected and Cancelled orders are excluded from the default view. - Printed orders appear under "Authorised" and under the default view. Query shape: - `isset($OrderNumber) AND != ''` -> select by `purchorders.orderno=filter_number_format($OrderNumber)`. - `!isset($OrderNumber) OR == ''` -> an empty `StockLocation` defaults to `$_SESSION['UserStockLocation']`. - Supplier and stock-item filters combine four ways: both set, supplier only, item only, neither. Each variant also filters on `intostocklocation=$_POST['StockLocation']` plus the status criteria. - The query joins purchorders, purchorderdetails, suppliers and currencies. It returns `SUM(unitprice*quantityord) AS ordervalue`, grouped by order. - `DB_num_rows > 0` -> render the orders table: View link, Supplier, Currency, Requisition, Order Date, Delivery Date, Initiator, Order Total (formatted by `currdecimalplaces`), Status. ### SalesCategories.php - Keywords and StockCode both set -> Keywords are used, with a message saying so. - `mb_strlen(SalesCatName) > 50 or trim(SalesCatName) == ''` -> `$InputError=1`. - `isset($SelectedCategory) and $InputError != 1` -> UPDATE salescat. - `$InputError != 1` and no SelectedCategory -> INSERT INTO salescat. - `StockCat == 'All'` -> `'%'`. - Paging: Next -> `$Offset = CurrPage+1`; Prev -> `CurrPage-1`; unset -> 0; `<0` -> 0; `>$ListPageMax` -> `$ListPageMax`. - `DB_num_rows(CountResult)==0` -> `$ListPageMax=1`, else `ceil(count/DisplayRecordsMax)-1`. - `DB_num_rows(SearchResult)==0` -> message "There are no products available meeting the criteria specified". - `!in_array(stockid, $ItemCodes)` -> the item row is shown, so items already in the category are hidden from the add list. - `!isset($_GET['Select'])` -> list categories with edit, delete and add-items links and images. - `isset($_GET['Edit'])` -> load the form from `salescat WHERE salescatid`. - Otherwise -> a blank new-category form, with `ParentCategory` from `$ParentCategory` or 0. - `active==1` -> "Yes", else "No". - A missing or empty parent name -> "No parent". - `isset($_GET['Select'])` -> list `salescatprod` joined to `stockmaster` and `manufacturers`; no rows -> "No Inventory items in this category". - Category image: `glob(part_pics_dir/SALESCAT_.{ext})`, then `GetImageLink`. - Stock-category dropdown source: `stockcategory WHERE stocktype='F' OR stocktype='M'`, so only finished goods and raw materials are offered. ### SelectProduct.php — item detail view Item status and type: - `discontinued==1` -> "Obsolete". - `mbflag` A -> "Assembly Item". - `mbflag` G -> "Phantom Assembly Item". Kitset flag set. - `mbflag` K -> "Kitset Item". Kitset flag set. - `mbflag` D -> "Service/Labour Item". Dummy flag set; `stocktype=='L'` also sets the labour flag. - `mbflag` B -> "Purchased Item". - Any other `mbflag` -> "Manufactured Item". - Serialised: `serialised==1` -> "serialised"; `elseif controlled==1` -> "Batchs/Lots"; else "N/A". Price and cost: - Price is queried when `in_array($PricesSecurity, AllowedPageSecurityTokens) OR !isset($PricesSecurity)`. - Price query: `prices` where `currabrev` is the company default currency, `typeabbrev=$_SESSION['DefaultPriceList']`, `debtorno=''`, `branchcode=''`, and the date range covers today. - No price row -> "No Default Price Set", price 0. - `mbflag` K, A or G -> cost is `SUM(bom.quantity*stockmaster.actualcost)` over BOM rows effective today. Otherwise cost is `$MyRow['cost']`. - `in_array($CostSecurity, tokens)` -> show cost and gross profit; `Price>0` -> gross-profit percentage, else "N/A". Properties: - Properties come from `stockcatproperties WHERE reqatsalesorder=0`. - Property value: no row -> "Not Set". - `controltype` 0 or 1 -> text. - `controltype` 2 -> Not Set / Yes (value 1) / No. Quantities: - `mbflag` A, D or K -> QOH and QOO are "N/A". - `mbflag` M or B -> QOH and QOO come from `GetQuantityOnHand` and `GetQuantityOnOrder` (`'ALL'`). Demand comes from `GetDemand`. These functions' behaviour is not in this topic. - `mbflag` G is in neither list, so its QOH and QOO are not set by these rules. Menu and links: - Suppliers table: `(mbflag=='B' OR 'M') AND in_array($SuppliersSecurity, tokens)`. A preferred supplier shows "Yes", else "No". - `!$Its_A_Kitset_Assembly_Or_Dummy` -> StockStatus, StockUsage, sales and purchase order links, picture, quantity adjustments, location transfers. - `!$Its_A_Dummy` -> BOMInquiry, WhereUsedInquiry. - `Its_A_Labour_Item` -> labour WhereUsedInquiry link. - `mbflag=='B' AND suppliers token AND discontinued==0` -> a New Order link per distinct supplier to `PO_Header.php`, with suppliers ordered by `effectivefrom DESC`. `Quantity` is the supplier's `minorderqty` if `eoq < minorderqty`, else `eoq`. - `!$Its_A_Kitset` -> Insert, Modify, Pricing, Discount Category, Clone, Related Items, Price Matrix links. - A non-empty `$_SESSION['CustomerID']` -> a Special Prices link. ### SelectProduct.php — search - `GenerateStockmasterQuery($post)`: Keywords (length > 0) matches `stockmaster.description`. Otherwise StockCode matches `stockmaster.stockid`. Otherwise SupplierStockCode matches `purchdata.suppliers_partno`. Otherwise there is no text filter. - Each criterion is `LIKE` on the uppercased input, wrapped in `%`, with spaces replaced by `%`. - `StockCat != 'All'` -> adds `AND stockmaster.categoryid=...`. - Keywords uses a LEFT JOIN on locstock. StockCode and SupplierStockCode use an INNER JOIN, so items with no locstock rows drop out of those two searches. - The query returns `SUM(locstock.quantity) AS qoh`, ordered by `discontinued, stockid`. - Both Keywords and StockCode set -> an info message that Keywords were used. - `DB_num_rows==0` -> "No stock items were returned...". - Results render when `isset($SearchResult) AND !isset($_POST['Select'])`. - Page controls render when `ListCount>0 and ListPageMax>1`. - Paging: Next with `PageOffset < ListPageMax` -> +1; Previous with `PageOffset > 1` -> -1; `PageOffset > ListPageMax` -> `ListPageMax`. - Rows are limited by `$RowIndex <> DisplayRecordsMax`, after `DB_data_seek` to `(PageOffset-1)*DisplayRecordsMax`. - `mbflag=='D'` -> QOH "N/A". `discontinued==1` -> "Obsolete". Image is the first glob match, else ''. ### Z_ItemsWithoutPicture.php - A row is listed only if `!file_exists($ImageFile)`, where `$ImageFile` is the first glob match for png, jpg or jpeg. - The header row prints once, when `$PrintHeader` is true. `$i` counts from 1. - Discontinued items and stocktype `D` items are never listed. ## Order and failure - Nothing in this topic wraps its writes in a transaction. SalesCategories.php runs plain `DB_query` calls with no error handler. - AddItems reports success without checking `DB_error_no()`. - In the AddItems loop, items without a brand are refused and the others are inserted. - Every page passes an error message to `DB_query` and has no handler of its own. A failure goes to `DB_query`'s own reporting (behaviour not in this topic). - SelectProduct.php loops over the search rows and, per row, runs a `stockitemproperties` query for each property. - `Z_ItemsWithoutPicture.php` and the other glob calls have no handling if the directory is missing or unreadable. ## Connections ### GetImageLink — `webERP/includes/ImageFunctions.php` - SalesCategories.php calls `GetImageLink($ImageFile, 'SALESCAT_', 64, 64, "", "")`. - SelectProduct.php calls `GetImageLink($ImageFile, stockid, 100, 100, "", "")`. - If `extension_loaded('gd') AND function_exists('gd_info') AND file_exists($ImageFile) AND !empty($Item)`: it returns an ``. - When `$_SESSION['ShowStockidOnImages']=='0'` there is no `text=` parameter. - Otherwise the URL adds `text=$Item`, unescaped. - `elseif file_exists($ImageFile)` -> a plain ``. - Otherwise it returns the text "No Image". - It does not check permissions. - `getImageTag($stockid)` in the same file returns a base64 35x35 `` for the first of png, jpg, jpeg found in `part_pics_dir`, else ''. These pages do not call it. ### StockStatus.php — `webERP/StockStatus.php` - Receives `?StockID=` from SelectProduct.php. - It trims and uppercases `StockID`, taken from GET first, then POST. - It reads `stockmaster`, and `locstock` joined to `locations` and `locationusers` with `canview=1` for the current user. Location rows are therefore limited to what the user may view. - For kitset (K), assembly (A) or dummy (D) items it shows only Location and Demand, plus an info message. - `UpdateBinLocations` writes `locstock.bin` in uppercase. - It has no permission check on StockID itself. ### Stocks.php — `webERP/Stocks.php` - Target of the Insert, Modify and Clone links. - It validates: Description 1–50 characters, LongDescription non-empty, StockID with no illegal characters or spaces, Units ≤ 20, BarCode ≤ 20, and numeric non-negative Volume, GrossWeight, NetWeight and EOQ. - Other checks: Serialised requires Controlled; NextSerialNo only for MBFlag `M` and Serialised items; MBFlag A, K, D or G cannot be Controlled. - MBFlag changes are blocked by on-hand stock, open sales orders, open purchase orders, and BOM membership. - Picture upload accepts only png, jpg or jpeg. It is limited by `MaxImageSize` KB and `part_pics_dir` must be writable. It replaces any existing `.` file. - Pictures are stored as `part_pics_dir/.`, the same path the picture globs in this topic read. - Item updates run in a transaction. ### StockCategories.php — `webERP/StockCategories.php` - Link target when no stock categories exist. - It maintains `stockcategory` rows with CategoryID ≤ 6 characters, description ≤ 20, and StockType in D, F, L, M. - Delete is refused if `stockmaster`, `salesglpostings` or `cogsglpostings` rows reference the category. - `DeleteProperty` has no permission check or confirmation. - Stock categories are separate from sales categories (`salescat`). SalesCategories.php only reads `stockcategory` for its dropdown. ### Other connections - `PO_OrderDetails.php` (link target), `PO_Header.php` (link target, parameters above) and `GenerateStockmasterQuery` (builds the search SQL). - Their internals were not looked up (behaviour not in this topic). - The tables read or written are `salescat`, `salescatprod`, `stockmaster`, `stockcategory`, `manufacturers`, `prices`, `bom`, `stockcatproperties`, `stockitemproperties`, `purchdata`, `suppliers`, `currencies`, `purchorders`, `purchorderdetails` and `locstock`. ## Conclusions - The default purchase-order view hides Rejected and Cancelled orders. Selecting "Authorised" also returns Printed orders. - The purchase-order filter has no status value for Printed alone. - The text search takes only one criterion. If Keywords is filled, StockCode and SupplierStockCode are ignored. - StockCode and SupplierStockCode searches drop items that have no `locstock` rows. The Keywords search keeps them with a NULL quantity. - The sales-category add-item dropdown lists only stocktype F and M categories. Labour and dummy categories cannot be chosen there. - Adding the same item to a category twice is not guarded in code, apart from hiding items already in the category from the list. - Repeating AddFeature or RemoveFeature, or deleting the same item again, repeats the same UPDATE or DELETE and changes nothing further. - Price and cost display depends on tokens 12 and 18. The price query also runs when `$PricesSecurity` is unset. - The supplier table and New Order links depend on token 9. - For `mbflag` G, QOH and QOO are not set by the shown rules. - Z_ItemsWithoutPicture.php depends on the same `part_pics_dir/.` naming that Stocks.php writes. It excludes discontinued items and dummy (`D`) stock types. - The "Items without picture" report ignores image files that are not png, jpg or jpeg. - A change to the Stocks.php upload rules (extensions or path) would change what this report and the picture globs find. - A change to StockCategories.php rules does not reach the independent `salescat` rules in SalesCategories.php. ## Hazards - SQL is built by concatenating `$SelectedSupplier`, `$SelectedStockItem`, `$StockID`, search strings and `$SelectedCategory`, with no escaping shown. - SalesCategories.php has no permission check for edits, deletes or featuring, no duplicate guard on `salescatprod`, and no check that the category exists. - Deletes via GET (`DelStockID`) happen with no confirmation. - The `GetImageLink` URL puts `$Item` unescaped in `text=`. - A missing `part_pics_dir` or an unreadable directory is not handled. - Price, cost and supplier displays rely only on token arrays in the session. ## Connected topics Topics this one exchanges work or records with, wherever they sit in the map (paths from the export's root): - <?php

// INCREASE SIZE OF stockmaster.stockid FROM 20 CHAR TO 64 CHAR
//    https://github.com/timschofield/webERP/discussions/812
//      - Parts&Vendors allows 50 char
//      - @pakricard OpenCart store allows 64 char
// 
// 1. delete foreign key constraints (Bottom-Up-Drop aka BUD)
//
// SQL query to list foreign key constraints on stockmaster.stockid:
//
//     SELECT 
//         TABLE_NAME AS 'Referencing Table', 
//         COLUMN_NAME AS 'Foreign Key Column', 
//         CONSTRAINT_NAME AS 'Constraint Name'
//     FROM 
//         information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE
//     WHERE 
//         REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME = 'stockmaster' 
//         AND REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME = 'stockid'
//         AND TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE(); -- Limits results to your current webERP database
//
//   +-----------------------------+--------------------+------------------------------------+
//   | Referencing Table           | Foreign Key Column | Constraint Name                    |
//   +-----------------------------+--------------------+------------------------------------+
//   | bom                         | parent             | bom_ibfk_1                         |
//   | bom                         | component          | bom_ibfk_2                         |
//   | contractbom                 | stockid            | contractbom_ibfk_3                 |
//   | custitem                    | stockid            | custitem_ibfk_1                    |
//   | locstock                    | stockid            | locstock_ibfk_2                    |
//   | loctransfers                | stockid            | loctransfers_ibfk_3                |
//   | mrpdemands                  | stockid            | mrpdemands_ibfk_2                  |
//   | offers                      | stockid            | offers_ibfk_2                      |
//   | orderdeliverydifferenceslog | stockid            | orderdeliverydifferenceslog_ibfk_1 |
//   | pickreqdetails              | stockid            | pickreqdetails_ibfk_1              |
//   | prices                      | stockid            | prices_ibfk_1                      |
//   | purchdata                   | stockid            | purchdata_ibfk_1                   |
//   | recurrsalesorderdetails     | stkcode            | recurrsalesorderdetails_ibfk_2     |
//   | salescatprod                | stockid            | salescatprod_ibfk_1                |
//   | salesorderdetails           | stkcode            | salesorderdetails_ibfk_2           |
//   | stockcheckfreeze            | stockid            | stockcheckfreeze_ibfk_1            |
//   | stockcounts                 | stockid            | stockcounts_ibfk_1                 |
//   | stockitemproperties         | stockid            | stockitemproperties_ibfk_1         |
//   | stockitemproperties         | stockid            | stockitemproperties_ibfk_3         |
//   | stockitemproperties         | stockid            | stockitemproperties_ibfk_5         |
//   | stockmoves                  | stockid            | stockmoves_ibfk_1                  |
//   | stockrequestitems           | stockid            | stockrequestitems_ibfk_2           |
//   | stockrequestitems           | stockid            | stockrequestitems_ibfk_4           |

// 1.1 drop grandchild fk constraints
// - indicated by error when attempting to resize grandchild foreign key columns without first deleting constraints
// DropConstraint($Table, $Constraint)
DropConstraint('stockserialmoves', 'stockserialmoves_ibfk_2'); // compound fk constraint

// 1.2 drop child fk constraints
// DropConstraint($Table, $Constraint)
DropConstraint('bom', 'bom_ibfk_1');

DropConstraint('contractbom', 'contractbom_ibfk_3');
DropConstraint('custitem', 'custitem_ibfk_1');
DropConstraint('locstock', 'locstock_ibfk_2');
DropConstraint('loctransfers', 'loctransfers_ibfk_3');
DropConstraint('mrpdemands', 'mrpdemands_ibfk_2');
DropConstraint('offers', 'offers_ibfk_2');
DropConstraint('orderdeliverydifferenceslog', 'orderdeliverydifferenceslog_ibfk_1');
DropConstraint('pickreqdetails', 'pickreqdetails_ibfk_1');
DropConstraint('prices', 'prices_ibfk_1');
DropConstraint('purchdata', 'purchdata_ibfk_1');
DropConstraint('recurrsalesorderdetails', 'recurrsalesorderdetails_ibfk_2');
DropConstraint('salescatprod', 'salescatprod_ibfk_1');
DropConstraint('salesorderdetails', 'salesorderdetails_ibfk_2');
DropConstraint('stockcheckfreeze', 'stockcheckfreeze_ibfk_1');
DropConstraint('stockcounts', 'stockcounts_ibfk_1');
DropConstraint('stockitemproperties', 'stockitemproperties_ibfk_1');
DropConstraint('stockitemproperties', 'stockitemproperties_ibfk_3');
DropConstraint('stockitemproperties', 'stockitemproperties_ibfk_5');
DropConstraint('stockmoves', 'stockmoves_ibfk_1');
DropConstraint('stockrequestitems', 'stockrequestitems_ibfk_2');
DropConstraint('stockrequestitems', 'stockrequestitems_ibfk_4');
DropConstraint('stockserialitems', 'stockserialitems_ibfk_1');
DropConstraint('woitems', 'woitems_ibfk_1');

// 2. change "stockid" parent, child and grandchild foreign key columns (bottom-up order, same as BUD for fk constraints)
// 2.1 change grandchild fk columns

// 2.2 change child fk columns

ChangeColumnSize('component', 'bom', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'contractbom', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'custitem', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'locstock', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'loctransfers',  'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'mrpdemands', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'offers', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'orderdeliverydifferenceslog', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'pickreqdetails', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'prices', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'purchdata', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stkcode', 'recurrsalesorderdetails', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'salescatprod', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');

ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'stockcheckfreeze', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'stockcounts', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'stockitemproperties', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'stockmoves', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'stockrequestitems', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'woitems', 'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');

// 2.3 change parent key column (stockmaster.stockid)
// ChangeColumnSize($Column, $Table, $Type, $Null, $Default, $Size)
ChangeColumnSize('stockid', 'stockmaster',  'VARCHAR(64)', ' NOT NULL ', '', '64');


// 3. add (re-add) fk constraints (Top-Down-Add aka TDA)
// 3.1 add child fk constraints
// AddConstraint($Table, $Constraint, $Field, $ReferenceTable, $ReferenceField)
AddConstraint('bom', 'bom_ibfk_1', 'parent', 'stockmaster', 'stockid');
AddConstraint('bom', 'bom_ibfk_2', 'component', 'stockmaster', 'stockid');
AddConstraint('contractbom', 'contractbom_ibfk_3', 'stockid', 'stockmaster', 'stockid');
AddConstraint('custitem', 'custitem_ibfk_1', 'stockid', 'stockmaster', 'stockid');
AddConstraint('locstock', 'locstock_ibfk_2', 'stockid', 'stockmaster', 'stockid');
AddConstraint('loctransfers', 'loctransfers_ibfk_3', 'stockid', 'stockmaster', 'stockid');
AddConstraint('mrpdemands', 'mrpdemands_ibfk_2', 'stockid', 'stockmaster', 'stockid');
AddConstraint('offers', 'offers_ibfk_2', 'stockid', 'stockmaster', 'stockid');
AddConstraint('orderdeliverydifferenceslog', 'orderdeliverydifferenceslog_ibfk_1', 'stockid', 'stockmaster', 'stockid');
AddConstraint('pickreqdetails', 'pickreqdetails_ibfk_1', 'stockid', 'stockmaster', 'stockid');
AddConstraint('prices', 'prices_ibfk_1', 'stockid', 'stockmaster', 'stockid');

content.text:
I've added item notes: a new notes page reachable from the item's page, plus an optional notes column in the stock-item CSV import. Nothing has been run or tested, since there was nothing to run against.

**Storage**
- A new `stocknotes` table holds the note text, the item code, the user who wrote it and the date.
- It is defined in `install/sql/tables/stocknotes.sql` for fresh installs and in `sql/updates/44.php` for upgrades. The upgrade also registers the new page in `scripts`.
- The page is registered with security token 11, which is my guess at the right level for item maintenance (the part-code importer uses it). Change it if you want something else.
- The fresh-install registration is in `install/sql/data/scripts.sql`. It is needed separately because a fresh install sets the update number to the highest file, so update 44 never runs there.

**Add, view, edit, delete**
- `StockNotes.php` lists an item's notes, oldest first.
- It has Edit and Delete links, the delete behind a confirm prompt.
- A single form adds a new note or saves an edit. Empty notes are refused.
- `SelectProduct.php` has a "Maintain Item Notes" link beside "Modify Item Details".

**Other pages that touch the item**
- `Stocks.php` now deletes an item's notes before deleting the item. Without this the foreign key would block deleting any item that has notes.
- `Z_ChangeStockCode.php` now carries the notes over when an item code is renamed.

**Import**
- `Z_ImportStocks.php` now accepts an optional 19th `Notes` column. Several notes in one cell are separated by `|`.
- Old 18-column files still import as before. The template download now includes the `Notes` header.
- Notes are inserted in the same transaction as the item, so a bad row rolls them back too.

**Caveats**
- Cloning an item (`StockClone.php`) does not copy its notes.
- A note can't contain a `|` when importing, because it is the separator.
- I didn't check whether posted text is already escaped by the session bootstrap. The new page and importer follow the surrounding code, which builds SQL by concatenating strings. If the text is not escaped elsewhere, these queries inherit that injection risk.
- On an error, the note you typed may be shown back with extra escaping.
